text:
alex: Heads-up: noticed a sustained increase in per-token latency for routes using tool/function calls since yesterday. Grafana panel shows P95 token latency up ~2.8x. Link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abc123/token-latency

alex: Root cause looks correlated with validation time in the structured-output/validation stage + KV cache miss rates for long-prefix requests. Quick snapshots below.

alex: prom query (token-level breakdown) we used:
```
# per-token milliseconds by stage (validation, runtime, kv, network)
sum by(stage) (rate(inference_token_duration_ms_sum{job="runtime",route="/chat",stage=~"validation|runtime|kv|network"}[5m])) 
/
sum by(stage) (rate(inference_token_duration_ms_count{job="runtime",route="/chat",stage=~"validation|runtime|kv|network"}[5m]))
```

alex: sample profiling trace (from perf flame):
```
2026-03-16T14:22:03Z trace_id=0x7f23 kernel_selector: chose fallback_fp32 for attention_cu at seq_len=768
2026-03-16T14:22:03Z trace_id=0x7f23 validation: validate_structured_output took 18.4ms (was 2.1ms typical)
2026-03-16T14:22:03Z trace_id=0x7f23 kv_cache: miss (prefix mismatch) added 4.7ms
```

maria: I dug into the perf traces — two things jump out: kernel selector preferring fp32 kernels for some attention sizes (seq>512) *and* validation path spiking when payloads include nested arrays (more schema checks). Also seeing retries from function-caller when validation returns 400-ish transient errors (we retry with backoff).

maria: Perf-collector snapshot:
```
- top 3 contributors to token latency (P95): validation 42%, runtime kernels 33%, kv 15%
- validation histogram: mean 3.2ms -> 12.6ms, p99 65ms
- kernel-selector: fallback rate for attention_cu @ seq_len 512-1024 = 18%
```

perf-ci-bot: perf-regression: tools/validate_structured_output increased by +1.9x in median vs baseline (commit 5f3a2c). See job: perf/inference/2026-03-16/7890

jonathan: Thanks — a few immediate instrumentation asks:
- add kernel_variant label to inference_token_duration_* metrics (values: native_fp16, native_int8, fallback_fp32)
- expose validation_substep label (json_parse, schema_check, pattern_validate)
- add kv_hit boolean label so dashboards can split hits vs misses

jonathan: Example PromQL for per-route token P95 by stage:
```
quantile_over_time(0.95, sum by(route,stage) (rate(inference_token_duration_ms_sum[5m])) / sum by(route,stage) (rate(inference_token_duration_ms_count[5m])))
```

alex: Agreed. Also request adding histogram buckets for validation durations (1ms, 2ms, 5ms, 10ms, 20ms, 50ms, 100ms) so p99 is stable.

lisa: Is this customer-facing? Any impact on SLAs?

alex: Probably not yet for most customers, but routes with heavy tool-calls (internal analytics app + two enterprise customers) could see elevated tail latency. Recommend we product-notify for the two flagged customers and open a support ticket.

maria: For immediate mitigation, two quick actions:
1) tighten validation to skip expensive schema checks for known-good route param sets (opt-in via route flag)
2) force kernel selector to prefer native paths for seq_len in 512-1024 for attention_cu on A100 (temporary safe-guard)

maria: I can prototype kernel_selector metric + a small config tweak. Will post PR with feature flag.

jonathan: I'll add the metrics endpoints in platform exporter and update grafana dashboard templates. Plan: new panels for token-level breakdown (validation vs runtime vs kv vs network), kernel_variant heatmap, and per-route toolcall retry rate.

alex: Let's also add an alert: when validation p95 > 10ms for >5m AND toolcall_retry_rate > 1% -> alert on-call and perf.

perf-ci-bot: Registered perf alert rule draft: perf/inference/validation_p95_high. Thresholds: p95>10ms for 5m.

deploy-bot: Rolling out perf metrics exporter change to staging (canary=5%) now.

alex: OK plan — action items:
- maria: PR for kernel_selector metric + feature flag (ETA: EOD)
- jonathan: exporter + dashboard panels (ETA: tomorrow)
- lisa: prepare customer comms for the two customers (ETA: EOD)
- perf: run regression job after PRs merged and tag any fallout

lisa: noted, will draft comms.

alex: I'll follow up with a 30m deep-dive tomorrow 10:00am PT. Add any logs/traces to the thread. :thumbsup:
